title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first face by creating a new two-dimensional sketch on the X-Y plane. In this sketch, draw the first loop by adding a circle with its center at coordinates [0.375, 0.375] and a radius of 0.375. Next, draw the second loop by adding another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.3543. Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust the size accordingly. Transform the two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0242 units, ensuring that the operation creates a new solid body. The final dimensions of this part are a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.75 units, and a height of 0.024193548387096774 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.375, 0.375)  # Move to the center of the circles
    .circle(0.375)         # Outer circle
    .circle(0.3543)        # Inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0242)

# Final model
r = extrusion

import cadquery as cq

# Define the parameters for the ring
outer_diameter = 0.7500
inner_diameter = 0.7260
thickness = 0.0242

# Create the ring
ring = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_diameter / 2)
    .circle(inner_diameter / 2)
    .extrude(thickness)
)

# Assign the final solid to variable r
r = ring

import cadquery as cq

outer_d = 0.7500
z = 0.0242
wall = 0.0242

outer_r = outer_d / 2.0
inner_r = outer_r - wall

outer = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_r).extrude(z)
inner_cut = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inner_r).extrude(z * 1.2).translate((0, 0, -z * 0.1))

r = outer.cut(inner_cut)
